Steno Diabetes Center is a specialized hospital in Denmark that is tracked in national clinical quality databases for its treatment outcomes. In the context of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database's annual report covering the period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, the center was evaluated on key clinical performance indicators, specifically severe bleeding and mortality within one year [^src1]. 

Due to its specialized focus and limited size regarding this specific patient demographic, the center's data reflects extremely low patient volumes for atrial fibrillation-related outcomes. For both severe bleeding and one-year mortality, the reported figures show 0 events out of a total of 5 patients [^src1]. The statistical confidence intervals for these metrics are wide (0.0 to 52.2), which is expected given the small sample size, and the center is marked with a "#" for certain sub-metrics, indicating insufficient data for full calculation or standard comparative reporting [^src1]. Ultimately, these figures highlight the center's distinct patient group and small sample size in this clinical area, rather than serving as a direct basis for broad clinical performance comparisons with larger, general hospitals.
